# Steve Yonga

> QA Automation Engineer based in Houston, TX, with 10 years of experience in manual, API, and UI test automation across e-commerce, life insurance, and mortgage finance. U.S. citizen with an active Public Trust clearance. Most recently the primary QA at WebstaurantStore (Jan 2023 – Sep 2026), leading day-to-day testing for a team of three QA engineers.

## Experience

- WebstaurantStore LLC (Jan 2023 – Sep 2026): Quality Assurance Automation Engineer. Primary QA on a small team; led day-to-day testing for three QA teammates, owned the automation suite, and cut regression time by 30% by pushing repeatable checks to the API layer.
- Legal & General America / Banner Life (Jun 2018 – Dec 2022): QA Automation Engineer for life insurance platforms, including Section 508 accessibility validation.
- Freddie Mac (Sep 2016 – Jun 2018): QA Automation Engineer in mortgage finance.

## Skills

- Test automation: Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, WebdriverIO, Cypress
- Languages: TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, Java, C#
- API testing: REST Assured, Postman
- Performance testing: Apache JMeter, k6, Gatling
- CI/CD and cloud: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Microsoft Azure
- Data: SQL, Snowflake, MongoDB
- Mobile and accessibility: BrowserStack mobile testing (manual and automation), Section 508 validation with NVDA

## Approach

- Validate UI, API, and database together; the costly defects are the ones where the screen looks right and the data underneath is wrong.
- Flaky tests are quarantined, ticketed, and owned, never hidden behind silent retries.
- AI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) are used for scaffolding, edge cases, and test data, with every output human-reviewed.
